name: Grid
summary: A CSS-grid container — a fixed column count or a responsive auto-fit, with the DS gutter scale, track justify/align, and a responsive collapse.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-grid> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. It mirrors the AntD Row/Col vocabulary over a CSS grid: give it a fixed `columns` count (equal tracks) or a `min` track width for a responsive auto-fit; `gap` takes the named steps small/middle/large (8/16/24) as ONE value or `"h v"` for a separate horizontal/vertical gutter; `justify`/`align` position the tracks; and `responsive` lets a fixed-column grid reflow to fewer columns as the container narrows — no media queries. Layout only — it never paints a background. No interactive state → no motion. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Responsive collapse
spec.value: columns=N + responsive → tracks reflow to fewer as the container narrows

spec.label: Gutter scale
spec.value: none 0 · small 8 · middle 16 · large 24 (or a raw px number)

spec.label: Justify
spec.value: start · center · end · space-between · space-around · space-evenly (justify-content)

props.name: columns
props.desc: Fixed number of equal-width columns (minmax(0, 1fr) tracks)

props.name: min
props.desc: Minimum track width for a responsive auto-fit grid; wins over columns

props.name: gap
props.type: none | small | middle | large | number | "h v"
props.desc: Gutter between cells — a named DS step (8/16/24) / raw px, or two values "h v" for a separate horizontal/vertical gutter

props.name: gutter
props.desc: Alias of gap (AntD Row vocabulary); gap wins if both are set

props.name: justify
props.type: start | center | end | space-between | space-around | space-evenly

props.name: align
props.desc: Vertical alignment of the cells within their row (align-items)

props.name: responsive
props.desc: With columns=N, lets tracks collapse to fewer as the container narrows — no media queries

whenToUse.when: a two-dimensional layout — a card gallery, a stat row, an image grid
a one-dimensional flow where items size to content
the column count should follow the container width — prefer it over media queries

opinion.note: Reach for `min` (auto-fit) or `responsive` before hand-writing breakpoints — the grid reflows itself. Use `gap="h v"` when rows need tighter spacing than columns. Keep gutters on the named scale so spacing matches the rest of the surface. Grid is layout, never decoration: it paints no background.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 ships no measured Grid/Row-Col component set (the Figma "Grid" hits are icon glyphs, not a layout primitive), so the matrix is derived from the AntD 24-col Row/Col reference over a CSS grid + the DS spacing scale: fixed `columns` tracks, `min` auto-fit, a `responsive` collapse (columns fold as the container narrows), a `gutter` that takes one value or `[h,v]` (column-gap / row-gap), and `justify`/`align` of the tracks. A deliberate, documented layout extension; the only visual token it binds is inherited text colour. No interactive state → no motion (correctly gated as a container).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe uses gap="middle small" → an asymmetric [h,v] gutter (column 16 / row 8) over 3 fixed tracks.
